summary: The complete legal domain has only 10000 (n, k) pairs and any legal distance interval contains at most 201 positive candidates, which is too narrow for an honest runtime scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: k is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted and app-local implementations enumerate only max(1, n - k) through n + k, at most 2k + 1 candidates, and perform one constant-time bitwise test per candidate; neither source has a nested loop, recursion, or input-sized materialized collection.

The certificate regression checks both stored source forms on all 10000 legal (n, k) pairs against an independent positive-range distance oracle; authored cases cover both parameter bounds, clipped lower intervals, inclusive endpoints, powers of two, dense and alternating set bits, nonzero sums, and empty compatible sets.
